    n, m = logp_with_result.shape
    if n == 0 or m == 0:
        raise ValueError("Matrices must not be empty")
    if not (np.all(np.isfinite(logp_with_result)) and np.all(np.isfinite(logp_call_only)) and np.all(np.isfinite(logp_no_call))):

        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be finite and nonnegative")

    # Compute normalized weights
    t_offsets = np.arange(m, dtype=float)
    raw_weights = np.maximum(0.0, 1.0 - 0.2 * t_offsets)

    weighted_avg_no_call = logp_no_call @ norm_weights

    # Compute margins
    margins = weighted_avg_with_result - weighted_avg_no_call

    # Keep mask: margin >= threshold
    keep_mask = margins >= tau_filter

    return keep_mask, margins
